m6_transfer.revision_diff_and_validity_reason: Six exact owner-approved swaps replace Smelting Vat, The Mightstone and Weakstone, Uthros Research Craft, Padeem, Lich's Relic and Enthusiastic Mechanaut. M6 blueprint was DESIGN_ONLY_UNIMPLEMENTED_NOT_RUN, therefore no claim that unexecuted full game-state cases passed. Current M7 exact list passes seven finite unit methods plus 100/100 Oracle legality and whole-list strategic review. Some source scenarios use cards removed from M7 (E1, E2), so are remapped or deferred explicitly. Five required P0 finite model tests authored and source-mapped in canonical PR #84 after original M7 research PR #718; all include explicit normal and adversarial inputs, anchored to SHA. P1 full game-state cases DEFERRED and owner-visible; no global independent I/J seal.

P0.payable_fixture: Beginning of own combat with Mishra on battlefield and owned noncreature artifact in play as valid target; source retains MV six.

P0.adversarial_assertion: Invalid timing, absent Mishra, opponent-controlled source, creature source or removal before resolution rejects the copy.
P0.coverage_note: Finite source-mapped positive/adversarial predicate tests, not general Magic simulation.
